decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet builds directly on the firm's material and craftsmanship know-how, so the firm can read its premium-segment results and refine it, which supports keeping it.

The decorative carpet stays closely tied to existing designer collaborations and textile competence, though overlap with similar carpets and the earlier pruning of Product A keep the rationalization risk moderate.
The corner bench extends the firm's core seating and customization skills for residential and hospitality projects, where it can best assimilate feedback and improve the product.

The low-pile carpet fits the established textile offering, but several near-identical launches make it a candidate for further collection streamlining, so it is kept with an elevated risk of withdrawal.
